name: gemini-g
lessons: When a city offers recruits, use recruit to strengthen existing armies or raise new ones every turn.
When an army's supply is 1 or less, use supply to keep it from starving or losing strength.
When an army is adjacent to an undefended enemy city, use move to capture it immediately.
When holding key border cities threatened by enemy forces, use fortify to double or triple defensive strength.
When an army has low experience and is not immediately threatened, use drill to raise its combat readiness.
When enemy armies or fleets threaten core positions or blockade ports, use move or fleet orders to counter them immediately.
When our army outnumbers the adjacent enemy city garrison by at least 2:1 and is fully supplied, use move to attack and capture the city.
When a seaport enemy port has been bombarded by fleet attack and its garrison is weakened, use fleet invade to land forces and capture it.
strategy: In the next game, I will balance recruiting and drilling with aggressive movement and attacks. Rather than letting armies sit and drill indefinitely, I will use superior numbers to capture enemy cities, maintain supply lines, and prevent the Confederacy from dominating the map.
